name: William Roche
heroText: Senior CS student at NYU with a math minor, currently TA-ing the undergraduate software engineering course. I like solving problems, researching, and building things that are useful to people.
aboutText: I'm a senior at NYU studying Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics, after transferring from The College of New Jersey. I really enjoy learning, which is how I've ended up with a background this broad, and I like setting myself a challenge, as the interests below make fairly clear.
